solver_contract.integration: forward fourth-order Runge-Kutta on spherical latitude/longitude rates
solver_contract.spatial_interpolation: bilinear; all four corners must have jointly finite u and v
solver_contract.coastal_behavior: terminate before any RK4 stage with an invalid wet stencil or outside domain

release_contract.name: wet interior of schematic Drake Passage surface section
release_contract.weighting: equal-count method ensemble; not area, volume, or transport weighted

boundary: Kinematic surface tracks through one historical year of older OSCAR data. Track count and distance are not water-mass volume, residence, Lagrangian coherence, current boundary, temperature advection, full-depth circulation, or heat transport.
